scope: New independent 2D inviscid airfoil solver, explicit local tip-quality flags and expanded algorithm Help. Existing 3D numerical solver and worker bundles are unchanged.

airfoil_solver.method: Linear vortex sheet; analytic straight-panel influence integrals; midpoint no-penetration plus endpoint Kutta; pivoted LU; exterior tangential sheet jump; Bernoulli Cp and pressure/circulation lift cross-check
airfoil_solver.independent_reference: Exact Joukowski conformal mapping at 0 and 4 deg; 80, 160 and 320 total panels
airfoil_solver.coverage: NACA symmetric/cambered, five-digit, DAT coordinate profile and spanwise blend; zero-chord section refused; angle and panel limits enforced
airfoil_solver.limits: No viscosity/stall/transition/profile drag, no finite-wing induced effects. Half-density difference is a sensitivity indicator, not a guaranteed accuracy certificate.

tip_display: Actual base-mesh samples are retained. Rounded-tip zone and segments are amber/dashed. CSV flags rounded-tip samples. Zero-axis ticks are formatted as zero rather than floating-point noise.
help_sections: Panel algorithm: governing equation, geometry/symmetry, source/doublet matrix, Morino Kutta wake, linear solver, pressure gradient, loads, refinement and structural admission
Local tip uncertainty and reference-software equivalence limitations
Independent 2D algorithm, inputs, mesh cross-check, exports and 2D/3D distinction
